---
title: "Cell output with a language"
filters:
  - code-window
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
---

An engine can give the output of a cell a language of its own.
The block still holds the output of an executed cell, so the filter leaves it alone.

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```{.r}
[1] 1 4 9 16
```

:::
